description: Authorized compatibility fixtures, addressed by SHA-256. The harness never downloads these files and never writes them into git.
migration: Angry Birds, Tiny Tower, and Art of Glow are already committed on main. Their legacyRepoPath entries are grandfathered and closed. New apps must be placed under HVM_FIXTURE_ROOT at fixtureRelPath. Removing the in-repo IPAs is an owner decision; this manifest does not delete them. Once a fixture root is set, the harness does not fall back to the in-repo copies.

apps.name: Angry Birds
apps.notes: Subtype 6, minimum iOS 3.0. A 3 second smoke is not a title-screen proof. The 2026-10-21 audit saw an unimplemented tmpnam import and a mostly dark framebuffer.

apps.name: Tiny Tower
apps.notes: Subtype 9. The audit's 3 second run reached applicationDidBecomeActive. Unimplemented imports included CGFont queries and glPointSizePointerOES.

apps.name: Art of Glow
apps.notes: Subtype 9. The audit saw a varied framebuffer and unimplemented regcomp, regexec, regerror, and regfree.

apps.name: Clash Royale
apps.notes: Pinned client from tools/clash_royale_probe.py. Not in git. Absence is a skip, not a pass. The harness does not download the third-party URL; using that URL is an owner decision. A 3 second smoke is not the two-launch 21903 probe. See docs/CLASH_ROYALE_RESTORATION.md.
